name: post-9cc1496d residual combat-local action-trace grammar audit v1
question: After preserving every valid closure, does either untested within-card or within-one-enemy-action trace seam support one source-backed, alias-free and policy-expressible unary structural transform worth a separate zero-row design gate?

competingHypotheses.H1: At least one frozen abstract cell is source-supported, closure-alias-free and expressible and observable through the unchanged policy surface.
competingHypotheses.H0: Every frozen abstract cell lacks source support, aliases a valid closed family, or requires a new selector or unobservable mediator.
competingHypotheses.HI: The exact bounded audit cannot decide at its context, citation or execution cap.

design.method: mechanism-blocked zero-row audit; no simulator or ledger access
design.seamFactor: owner of the exact primitive-effect trace being transformed
design.operatorFactor: one unary transform applied in isolation to an already-present primitive subeffect trace
design.designMatrix: the exact 2 x 7 ordered Cartesian product, assessed without rows; no joint transforms
identityAnchors: S1_IDENTITY preserves the authored within-card primitive trace
S4_IDENTITY preserves the authored within-enemy-action primitive trace

closureAnchors.S2_BETWEEN_PLAYER_ACTIONS_SAME_TURN: existing action-order, Scoreline, Afterimage, repeat and private-state closures

design.interactionJustification: The audit asks whether any single structural edge remains. Combining transforms would make aliases and attribution non-identifiable and is prohibited.

excludedTransforms.scalarRescale: closed scalar family and not structural
excludedTransforms.crossSeamComposition: would reopen closed phase or ordering families
excludedTransforms.newPolicySelector: policy-repertoire invention before a measured bottleneck
excludedTransforms.TARGET_ACTS_LAST_THIS_PHASE: exact representation closed at the parent archive

operatorDefinitions.O1_PERMUTE_EXISTING_SUBEFFECTS: Change only the order of two or more already-authored primitive subeffects; preserve their multiset, values, targets and action boundary.
operatorDefinitions.O2_DROP_ONE_EXISTING_SUBEFFECT: Suppress exactly one already-authored primitive subeffect; preserve every remaining subeffect and order.
operatorDefinitions.O3_REPEAT_ONE_EXISTING_SUBEFFECT: Execute exactly one already-authored primitive subeffect one additional time; preserve every other subeffect and order.
operatorDefinitions.O4_SHIFT_ONE_SUBEFFECT_ACROSS_OWN_ACTION: Move exactly one already-authored primitive subeffect from its action trace to the immediately adjacent post-action settlement boundary without changing its value or target.
operatorDefinitions.O5_REMAP_ONE_SUBEFFECT_TARGET: Route exactly one already-authored primitive subeffect to another already-addressable combat target; preserve value, type and timing.
operatorDefinitions.O6_CONVERT_ONE_REALISED_RESULT_TYPE: Replace exactly one realised primitive result with a bounded result of another already-existing combat type; no scalar level is selected here.
operatorDefinitions.O7_GUARD_ONE_SUBEFFECT_ON_ANOTHER_REALIS: Execute exactly one already-authored primitive subeffect only when another subeffect in the same action produced its exact realised result.

H1_SOURCE_SEAM_FEASIBILITY.question: For every frozen cell, does exact current-main source contain the stated action trace and a mechanically real insertion seam, without judging closure or policy?

H2_IMMUTABLE_CLOSURE_ALIAS.question: For every frozen cell, does the abstract transform remain distinct from all supplied immutable closures, without inspecting current source or policy?

H3_POLICY_OBSERVABILITY.question: For every frozen cell, can the unchanged frozen policy express the relevant player choice and can direct instrumentation observe the mediator without a new selector?

estimands.perCell: the conjunction sourceSupported AND aliasFree AND policyExpressible AND mediatorObservable AND NOT newSelectorRequired
estimands.family: count of eligible abstract cells and the deterministic minimum rank among them

ranking.justification: Prefer direct player agency, an unchanged operation multiset and the smallest semantic and global-power disturbance; lexical cell id is the final tie-break.

decisionRules.success: If all three reports are COMPLETE and at least one cell passes every gate, freeze exactly the minimum-ranked abstract cell for one separate zero-row natural-opportunity and identity-design gate.
decisionRules.futility: If all three reports are COMPLETE and zero cells pass every gate, close this residual action-trace grammar and continue only if a distinct evidence-backed non-trace family remains.
decisionRules.inconclusive: If any exact report is INCONCLUSIVE or the audit cannot complete at cap, record inconclusive and do not select a cell.
decisionRules.prohibited: No agent or owner may adapt the matrix, operator definitions, ranks or gates after reading a report.

claimBoundary: A success selects one abstract action-trace cell for a later zero-row design gate only. It is not a card, relic, value, implementation, source identity proof, natural capacity, policy sensitivity, causal benefit, complementarity, reachability, detector, product, protected-seed, #421 acceptance or #108 P9 claim.
